author: ojiudezue
title: v5.78.0 shipped: LOST dissolution (evidence matrix) + memory writers + away-veto census hole
summary: Closes AWAY-BLOCK-1 on all three paths: 16-row GPS/WiFi/BLE evidence matrix replaces the overloaded LOST state (no-signal can never vote away; BLE-only 0.82 below the 0.9 threshold; liveness-gated BLE axis; per-tick source inventory), path-alpha now gates on camera-provable face evidence instead of BLE-contaminated census_count (forgotten phone no longer blocks away), and phone-left-behind consults room occupancy so camera-less rooms stop producing false flags. Four rate-bounded memory episode writers with wired restart-discharge. Three observability attrs on existing sensors, zero new entities. Riders: guest-FP A1 classifier, EV dupe-sensor removal + per-plug power.
